decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from time-rs/time PR #782 (closes issue #781), merged 2026-06-12T05:26:09Z. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. The strftime tokenizer reads the component byte at self.input[2] after a padding modifier (%_, %-, %0) without checking that it exists, so a format string ending right after the modifier panicked with an index-out-of-bounds instead of returning the parser's usual error; a lone trailing '%' was already handled. The fix in time/src/format_description/parse/strftime.rs splits the padding match out and uses get(2). IMAGE: this task requires vulcanbench/sandbox:rust-2024, NOT the vulcanbench/sandbox:rust used by the other Rust tasks. time is edition 2024 with rust-version 1.88.0, and its parsing code uses `let` chains (stabilized in 1.88); the :rust image pins 1.87.0 and fails with E0658. The MSRV is not load-bearing for a std-only build -- it only bites once the `parsing` feature is enabled, which is where this bug lives. sandbox/Dockerfile.rust-2024 was added for this rather than repinning :rust, so v3's Rust tasks and their published results stay reproducible on 1.87.0. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (edc58b1e), trimmed to the `time` and `time-core` workspace members (time-macros and all optional deps -- quickcheck, rand08/09/010, serde_core, js-sys, libc, num_threads -- are dropped along with dev-dependencies, tests and benches). The root manifest is hand-written and minimal: trimming the real one via cargo vendor pulled a 174M tree through dev-dependencies and optional features. Required deps are pinned to upstream's exact versions (deranged 0.5.8, num-conv 0.2.2, powerfmt 0.2.0) and vendored into repo/vendor (284K) with a .cargo/config.toml replace-source stanza; guessing those versions produced a misleading 'no method named widen' error, so keep them pinned. Default features are std+parsing+formatting because format_description is gated on `any(formatting, parsing)` and its parse submodule on alloc. Verified fully offline with `docker run --network none ... cargo build --offline`. MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses preserved. TEST LAYOUT: the workspace root is a virtual manifest, so hidden tests are nested at tests/time/tests/ to land in the `time` member rather than at an ownerless <ws>/tests/, and every test cmd passes -p time. Coverage: 5 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to panic at the base commit and return Err after the gold patch, spanning all three padding modifiers, a truncated modifier trailing a valid format string, and the parse_strftime_owned entry point. The 4 pass_to_pass guards cover modifiers followed by a component, ordinary format strings, the already-erroring lone '%', and the owned parser on valid input, so they compile and pass at the base commit. Assertions check only is_err()/is_ok(), never error text.
